The file /home/hyoklee/cae_test_data/porotomo/dasv_native_PoroTomo_iDAS025_160318160317.h5 contains exactly 8 datasets, all at the root group (no subgroups). Listed with shape and dtype:

1. /channel — shape (384,), dtype int32
2. /crs — shape () (scalar), dtype uint8
3. /das — shape (30000, 384), dtype float32
4. /t — shape (30000,), dtype float64
5. /trace — shape (30000,), dtype int64
6. /x — shape (384,), dtype float32
7. /y — shape (384,), dtype float32
8. /z — shape (384,), dtype float32

Interpretation: /das is the main DAS strain-rate array (30,000 time samples x 384 channels); /t is the time axis (float64 seconds); /trace is the trace index (int64); /channel is the channel index (int32); /x, /y, /z give the spatial coordinates of each of the 384 channels (float32); /crs is a scalar uint8 (coordinate reference system flag).
